(async () => { const waitFor = async (fn, ms = 3000) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = fn(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) return null; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 60)); } }; const row = document.querySelector('[data-sidebar-group="ungrouped"]'); const width = row.getBoundingClientRect().width; if (Math.abs(width - window.__align.width) > 0.5) throw new Error('hover 后行宽变化: ' + window.__align.width + ' → ' + width); const menu = row.querySelector('[data-sidebar-menu]'); if (!menu) throw new Error('分组行缺少 ⋯ 按钮'); const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.width < 24 || rect.height < 24) throw new Error('⋯ 热区不足 24×24: ' + rect.width + '×' + rect.height); if (Math.abs(rect.right - window.__align.rail) > 1) throw new Error('⋯ 右缘 ' + rect.right.toFixed(2) + ' 未落在轨道 ' + window.__align.rail.toFixed(2)); const shown = await waitFor(() => getComputedStyle(menu).opacity === '1'); if (!shown) throw new Error('hover 后 ⋯ 未显示，opacity=' + getComputedStyle(menu).opacity); if (getComputedStyle(row.querySelector('[data-sidebar-count]')).opacity !== '0') throw new Error('hover 后计数应让位给 ⋯'); return { width: +width.toFixed(2), menuRight: +rect.right.toFixed(2), hit: Math.round(rect.width) + 'x' + Math.round(rect.height) }; })()
